entities.name: Edmund Michał Piszcz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edmund Michał Piszcz was, from 22 October 1988, the bishop of Warmia, Poland. On 25 March 1992, he was promoted to the rank of archbishop, together with his diocese, the Archbishopric of Warmia. He retired on 30 May 2006.
